value_criterion: a complete, cookable dinner that tastes good and uses only lentils, a lemon, eggs, stale bread (plus water, salt, oil, dried spices and dried herbs)
pantry_rule: free: water, salt, oil, any dried spice or dried herb from a home spice rack (incl. garlic/onion powder, mustard powder). Out: fresh aromatics, dairy, flour, sugar, vinegar, stock, baking soda.
